text.p: Lithuania's Labour exchange said on Tuesday that unemployment rate in April went down to 5.9 percent from 6.2 percent in March.
Labour exchange also said in a statement that the unemployment rate in April 1996 was 8.0 percent.
The statement said the number of registered unemployed was 104,174 people at the end of April, 4,019 people less than a month ago.
The labour exchange said 52.6 percent of the registered unemployed were women.
Highest unemployment in April was in Salcininkai 11.9 percent, Svencionyse 11.5 percent and Ignalina 11.1 percent.
The lowest unemployment rate was in Plunge 2.7 percent, Prienai 2.7 percent and Anyksciai 2.9 percent.
